reviewFindings: high: frontend/src/pages/ModelHub.tsx:108-218 - statistics, channel management, routing explanation, filters, model grid and provider usage compete in one long undifferentiated page.
high: frontend/src/AppLayout.tsx:208-260 and frontend/src/components/MobileFab.tsx:115-155 - mobile navigation is duplicated across TabBar, draggable FAB and drawers.
high: frontend/src/AppLayout.tsx:308-325 - the desktop feature named right panel is implemented as a full-screen overlay, breaking the established three-column spatial model.
medium: frontend/src/pages/Themes.tsx:156-304 - theme page diverges from shared page headers and mixes normal appearance settings with developer token inspection.
medium: frontend/src/pages/System.tsx:87-187 - promotional capability cards precede higher-value runtime, update and network operations.

medium: frontend/src/pages/Tasks.tsx:103-109, frontend/src/pages/SessionDb.tsx:155 and frontend/src/components/ModelChannels.tsx:63-66 - empty states do not consistently use the existing EmptyState component.
medium: frontend/src/components/Message.tsx:29-167 - hardcoded purple, sky, red, emerald and gradient treatments bypass semantic theme tokens.
medium: frontend/src/pages/Apps.tsx:10-18 and 161-182 - five structurally different tools share one flat segmented control and the page description does not fully match its tabs.
childReport.manualNotes: Recommended remediation order: ModelHub, global navigation/right-panel architecture, Themes, System, Apps, then Tasks/SessionDb and chat color cleanup.
